warnings: TASK_INPUT_WARNING: source_discovery_not_yet_disease_generic — source discovery logic may not be fully generalized for influenza; validate source list manually.

TASK_INPUT_WARNING: extraction_record_model_still_hantavirus_named — ensure extraction schema field names are remapped to influenza context before ingestion; do not inherit hantavirus-specific field logic.

TIME_WINDOW: 2024-09-29 to 2024-10-05 corresponds to MMWR Week 40, the first week of the 2024-2025 influenza surveillance season; baseline activity is typically low at season start — expect minimal or low activity designations in most states.
DATA_AVAILABILITY: CDC FluView for MMWR Week 40 (2024-2025 season) may have been published with a 1–2 week lag; confirm report publication date before asserting data coverage.

CASE_COUNT_SEMANTICS: CDC does not report total national confirmed influenza case counts; primary metrics are percent positivity, ILI%, hospitalization rates, and pediatric death counts — do not expect a single national case total.
GEOGRAPHIC_COVERAGE: FluSurv-NET covers only select catchment areas (~9% of U.S. population); hospitalization data is not available for all states.
SUBTYPE_TRACKING: Record influenza A and B subtypes separately where reported; early season data may show limited subtype diversity.
VALIDATION: Cross-validate state-level reports against CDC FluView regional summaries to detect reporting inconsistencies.
EVIDENCE_QUOTE: Prioritize verbatim extraction of numeric data with surrounding context; include MMWR week reference and case definition language in evidence_quote field.

iterative_source_discovery_summary.stop_reason: Max iterations (2) reached per bounds constraint. The stop condition is also independently satisfied: the primary CDC FluView Week 40 source (week ending October 5, 2024) is confirmed, the Mississippi state PDF is confirmed for the exact task window, and additional state-level and international candidates appeared in iteration 2 results. Further searching would not be permitted under the stated bounds and is not needed given the confirmed primary source coverage.
iterative_source_discovery_summary.final_coverage_assessment: Core coverage is strong. The CDC FluView Week 40 report (week ending October 5, 2024) is confirmed as a candidate source and directly covers the task window at the national level with virus subtype data, positivity rates, and H5N1 case notes. The Mississippi state PDF explicitly covers Sept. 29–Oct. 5, 2024 with ILI rate data (2.8% state ILI rate, up from 2.3% prior week). PAHO results appeared (paho.org, iris.paho.org) for international corroboration, though the specific PAHO snippet retrieved is from December 2025 and is out of scope — the PAHO domain presence suggests a Week 40 2024 PAHO update may exist but was not surfaced in snippet form. State-level domains (health.ny.gov, dshs.texas.gov) appeared as candidates for subnational data. CIDRAP provides a credible secondary analytical source. The primary gap is that no Week 40 2024-specific PAHO or news snippet was confirmed in the metadata — however, the CDC FluView Week 40 source alone is sufficient as the gold-standard primary source for the task, and the Mississippi PDF provides confirmed subnational evidence. The max iteration bound prevents further refinement.
iterative_source_discovery_summary.final_trustworthiness_assessment: High. The two highest-value confirmed candidates are: (1) cdc.gov/fluview/surveillance/2024-week-40.html — official CDC FluView weekly report, gold-standard U.S. influenza surveillance, directly titled and dated for the task window; (2) msdh.ms.gov PDF — official Mississippi State Department of Health influenza surveillance report, explicitly dated "Sept. 29 – Oct. 5, 2024." Both are .gov domains with official public health agency authorship. Secondary candidates from health.ny.gov and dshs.texas.gov are also .gov official sources. CIDRAP (cidrap.umn.edu) is a well-regarded academic public health news source. PAHO results appeared but the specific snippet is temporally out of scope. Out-of-scope results (2025 FluView weeks, 2023-24 season summaries, Washoe County Week 10 2024-25) must not be used as evidence for the task window.
